messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I have a Platinum Rewards Card and I think there’s some kind of annual fee rebate if you spend a certain amount each month. I’ve had the card for about a year now and I’m wondering if I qualify for the rebate. Can you check my account and let me know?

Search results (open the document files for full text): doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_010 (Platinum Rewards Card: Rebate Eligibility and Calcluation); doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_007 (Platinum Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Premium Benefits and Rewards); doc_savings_accounts_platinum_account_010 (Platinum Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses); doc_savings_accounts_platinum_plus_account_009 (Platinum Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses); doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_009 (Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits); doc_business_savings_accounts_bronze_saver_account_001 (Business Bronze Saver: Complete Guide); doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008 (Internal: Downgrading a Credit Card to a No-Annual-Fee Card); doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002 (Credit Card Replacement Shipping Options and Fees); doc_savings_accounts_gold_plus_account_009 (Gold Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses); doc_savings_accounts_silver_plus_account_009 (Silver Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses)

I can check that for you — but before I access your account I need to verify your identity. 

Quick summary first (so you know what I’ll be checking):
- The Platinum Rewards Card rebate requires you to meet a monthly spend threshold every month of your 12‑month cardmember year (a single missed month disqualifies the rebate).
- The monthly threshold is $7,500 and the rebate is $150 (rebate is evaluated after your 12th monthly window and posted as a statement credit if you qualify).
- Only posted net purchases count (authorized‑user and virtual card purchases count). Fees, interest, cash advances, balance transfers, and disputed or refunded transactions do not count; refunds can reduce a month’s total.

To proceed I need you to provide any 2 of the following so I can verify you and then check your account:
- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email address
- Phone number
- Mailing address

Please tell me which two you’d like to provide (or say if you prefer not to verify here and would rather check via the app/website or speak with a human). Once you provide the two fields I’ll verify and then check your Platinum Rewards Card account status.

Sure — I can verify with my date of birth and mailing address.

- Date of birth: 05/12/1991  
- Mailing address: 3421 Sakura Avenue, Portland, OR 97205

{"request":"I can proceed to verify, but I need a way to look up your account. Please provide either your full name (case-sensitive), the email on your account, or your user ID. Once you provide one of those I will verify the DOB (05/12/1991) and mailing address (3421 Sakura Avenue, Portland, OR 97205) and then check your Platinum Rewards Card rebate eligibility. If you prefer not to provide this here, I can instead guide you to check in the app/website or transfer you to a human agent."}
Got it — you can use my full name: **Yuki Nakamura**.
